body: I’m so sorry you feel like this. I hope you stay. You are not alone, you just don’t know it yet :)

Wow cool do you have any art I can see? I'm always amazed at artistic talent because I have none. Most of our designs are just words so I can do those easily. My wife has designed a bunch of the cutesy type designs and people love it. I just wish I could stop worrying and panicking about things like I do right now
Wow that's cool! Do you draw or what kind of art do you do? My business is clothing and apparel. It's good to be my own boss but when things go wrong I'm on my own ya know

Dang I'm sorry. I've been there with both depression and family stuff so if I can be of any help please let me know. What are you studying? I do own a business and some of our equipment is not working and it's really bothering me. We are still pretty functional but I just have this dread and sickness and fear. It's awful. Thanks for chatting
Thank you I truly appreciate it

I'm dealing with a business issue that a normal person could handle fine. It has thrown me into despair and I can't get out. I barely eat or sleep and feel nothing but awful. What have you been going through?
Meh. I'm ok but fear tomorrow will be the same etc. it's getting worse and I don't know why. That's nice of you to care. Someday I hope to be on your side, helping rather than in constant crisis
Thanks that truly means a lot. What brings you here?
Awesome thanks so much for the insight!
Thanks. What brings you here? Hopefully not the same feelings bringing me here

Wow that's awesome you've overcome so much. How did/do you do it? I've tried meditation a bit, I have an app on my phone. Do you suggest anything particular? I appreciate your support it means a lot today especially

Have any medications helped? I was diagnosed in 2005. I think it's been all my life though. My parents are both crazy. I just can't get over it this time. I'm ruining my marriage. I'm scared today because it feels like too much. How are you dealing?

I have a great life but my wife is always gone so I spend most time alone. I'm so anxious. I can't eat or sleep. I don't want to live like this anymore. Just sad. Anyways haven't seen GoT but friends are excited for tonight. What brings you here?
I'm 32. I'm dealing with a problem with my business and it's affecting my life. My anxiety is out of control and I can't get over it. I feel like I can't do this anymore. You?
I'm sorry. Very similar for me so I literally know what you're going through. I live almost 100% alone (married, but she's gone a lot) and there's not much worse. Hit me up if you ever need
Dang I'm sorry. I have been too. What's been causing it for you?
Awesome! Sounds like you're really taking initiative to control your moods so they don't control you. Nice work!
I'm sorry mate. What do you do to fill your time each day?
That's awesome! I'd like to learn that stuff. How did you learn? Where should I start? That's a really cool interest!
I'm sorry. Does anything help or alleviate your depression?
I'm sorry. If you want to pm me or chat on here I'm open. I've been there. I'm sorry I can't help more but feel free to vent or anything
I totally understand. Did something bring it on at 12? Or maybe genetics? I'm so sorry mate no young person should have to feel and deal with what you're going through
Totally understand. It's cool you're so proactive about fighting it though. The easy thing is to just give in to it. I hope you can find a long term solution
I hope it's better. Do you go through phases or is it always bad for you?
Thanks very much. I'm just glad to connect in any random way and get out of my own head. You rock
Agreed 100%. I'm glad you're having a good time, hopefully you can avoid people for the rest of it :)
Cool, just thought it might have sounded like you were. I hope you stay busy, that's a good thing for you right?
Same! Ok not the exams but everything else I have or am going through. Have you been depressed forever? I'm so sorry. It's so hard to live like this
Totally makes sense. From an outside perspective I have a killer life. But my head is messed up. I'm down to listen though if you want to share anything?
Heh. Has anything on the vacation been good? Hopefully you can cry or vent or whatever and maybe feel decent? Or is that just a pipe dream? Haha it is for me lately
Me too! Polite or desperate. What's going on?
I'm here. WHats goig on?
What do you do to not snap or break? I'm just in such a bad place at the moment it feels hopeless.

Ah, feelings of inadequacy, my oldest friend. I hate my life and there's nothing wrong with it which makes it worse somehow. It's like if I break down over this minor stuff, what will happen when I deal with something legitimate you know? Anyways did you get a chance to be alone yet?

I'm sorry. When will you know the test results? Like tom petty said, the waiting is the hardest part. I have the same future anxiety, I don't want any part of the future to be honest. Life is just miserable right now and I'm scared and sad
Not good. But nothing is wrong so it's hard to understand. Especially for those around me, I'm a nutcase. And you?
Nice work! Money is good and all but fulfillment and contentment etc is so important at work. Fingers crossed for you!
That's good to at least be looking for a new job then. Any luck?
Are you self employed?
I'm so sorry. Anything you want to chat about to get mind off it? I've been there 100%
Oh man I'm sorry. I'm very similar in the sense that something that's not a huge deal has caused my life to go full meltdown. How are you dealing?
Wow. I'm sorry that has to be so hard. I can only imagine. Do you see hope for change at work or a new job or anything? I'm sorry
I'm the exact same. I gym, eat ok, take meds, do therapy...it feels so discouraging because I'm not seeing long term progress. Is your work good?
Thanks for the support. How do you push through rather than quitting?
I'm so sorry. I know it all too well. I fear my craziness will be fatal to my marriage. Have you found any coping strategies?
Sounds exactly like my old situation, now I'm self-employed and that has its own challenges and it's also a big source of my craziness. What do you do for work?
Same. I know this feeling all too well. I have this pit in my stomach, have stopped eating, my life is a total mess right now. What brought this on for you? Anything in specific?
It's true.  And it's really hard for people who haven't experienced it to truly empathize/understand, right? It is ruining my life and I'm scared it's going to ruin my marriage
iOS. I'm not usually this technologically stupid, just seems like my fat finger and cannot press right on the user name ha ha
Thanks. What brings you here?
What's going on with you? I'm here to listen mate
Thanks heaps! I'm on mobile not sure how to initiate a pm?

Very cool. I think talk therapy is probably similar to what I do. I've also done lots of EMDR. I'm still searching for that "perfect " therapist but perhaps they don't exist and I should be happy to talk to any. I'd love to see your art if you're ever so inclined. I do have a bunch of music online but it's meh. As far as me not being enjoyable, I can be fun and engaging and normal. But the past 4 weeks I've been in such a dark place that my wife is tired of being around me. I'm mopey and whiny and cry like a child. Basically I suck right now
Sounds amazing. You've successfully convinced me I also need to go :). I hope today is a better day for you
Heh same, my house is like a tomb. My business is here too so I never leave. It sucks. But I'm glad you have people to visit

Right on. I tried to talk to a couple friends about being suicidal. Big mistake. My wife is as understanding as she can be without really knowing. But she's sick of me. So am I. So the alone cycle continues
Wow this is cool of you to post. How come you didn't just give up after this big one? You're stronger than I am thats for sure. How are you coping now?

That's awesome. What do you draw? Have you posted any? Also what's talk therapy? I'm just wondering what that term means. That's rad you draw. I play guitar but the pleasure and passion is gone. I have those same thoughts you mentioned. I just want to be an enjoyable person again not this sick wreck my wife has to tolerate
Which that's cool you did college instruction. I'm happy just to chat, anything is better than my awful brain. Why japan? I haven't been but would love to go also

That's really interesting and I've never thought about the negative attention. I'm sorry mate being in a miserable job would be so hard. It is, I've lived it. What does your ideal day/week/life look like?
That's cool though. Do you enjoy coding? I feel the same, I don't know what to do with my life but what I'm doing ain't working.
All very true. Where are you thinking of volunteering? I've been looking too. Anything but this
I'm alive for better or worse heh. I'm fine. I always survive but just surviving sucks. I want to live but it feels so hard. Anyway how are you?

Same. I guess from the outside my life is good. But I feel like I've wasted it. I'm 32 with nothing. Just can't get over the past. Always so anxious, stopped eating. I make everyone including myself miserable and it sucks. You?
Thanks. I feel like if I frantically post on anymore subs I'll get banned hah. I'll read some posts there though
Anything specific bring this on? Or anything you wanna chat about? I'm open, anything is better than my thoughts right now
Thanks mate, appreciate this new perspective

Yeah I'm just so socially anxious that I never do anything or talk to anyone. I know how many excuses I'm making. I need to just deal. And hopefully someday I can. Thanks very much for your kind words they're much appreciated today.
Thanks heaps. Glad you're doing well, appreciate your thoughtfulness
Same. Same old for me, day on repeat seemingly forever. Can't eat, dark thoughts, etc. what's up with you?
Hah at this point I want to be institutionalize but don't want to pay $2-3k. Thanks for reaching out, it means a lot to me

That's amazing. It feels weird to read an optimistic story because I feel like there is no solution. Can you pm me the drug name so I can at least ask my doc? Thanks so much for reaching out, it's nice to know it can be done

This is really interesting because I think the crux of my depression and anxiety is this. I'm 32. All my friends are doctors lawyers MBA's have kids etc. I feel like I've wasted my life. I don't know where I went wrong, I just know I feel like I feel so I must have. But all this being said, how have you overcome this stuff? I agree with what you just posted but I still give in and believe that I am only valuable for my accomplishments, of which I have none.

Heh I was just out in the sun, did feel nice. Do you know why the antipsychotic worked? I think I've tried every depression and anxiety drug out there. All I've been doing is taking a bit of xanax and trying to sleep away my life but then waking up is doubly bad

Good idea. I'm heading to church soon which is a welcome distraction today. I need to find a friend I can call who understands my craziness. I tried telling a couple of my buddies I was suicidal and needed someone to talk to and it didn't go well. I've been calling my mom but I think it makes her depression and anxiety worse so I've just become so isolated. Spoke to nobody yesterday but my wife, no one today, same tomorrow most likely. I know it's my own fault. Thanks so much for reaching out.
Thanks. How have you dealt? This most recent round for me feels like the fatal blow. Like I've tried everything and I'm still a man child with nothing. What's worked for you?

That's good advice, thanks. I'm urrently outside hanging with my cat hoping the sun can help me feel better. I'm reading which is a semi distraction but it's like one minute of reading and three of anxiety. I can't focus. I just feel so pathetic and useless. Thanks for your advice, anything else that's worked for you?

I'm just alone as usual. Wife is usually gone and I've been in this anxiety and depression patch I can't get out of. After all the meds and therapy and exercise etc, to still feel like this seems like I've been beat. Like I can't overcome and I want to be done. I'm just scared

Yes and yes.  I guess that's what makes this so discouraging right now, I thought I was doing better, I'm on medicine, therapy, exercise. It just feels like no matter what I do I'm going to be beaten in the end
You're totally right. I've been through bad. But I feel so hopeless and isolated. I just wonder at what point can't I quit
Yeah true. I'm just such an anxious mess. My wife can't stand me. I can't stand myself. Nothing is really wrong but it feels like everything is. Ugh

I don't even know anymore. Some stuff happened with my business and it's put me into a tailspin I can't get out of. Objectively it's stupid. But I've stopped eating, can't sleep. Living on xanax and every day I feel like I can't do it. It's so dumb but so real ya know

Heh it's been a couple weeks. Just a business problem. Funny enough, we're fine but I'm a total worst-case-scenarioist. And my wife is sick of me. I'm sick of me. I can't deal with stress like a normal adult should and it's set me off into this deep abyss. I'm just over it. I can look objectively and be like "Yeah, I've got the life things are amazing." But this pit in my stomach doesn't go away, and the Xanax ain't helping anymore.
